H01.description: byte_length + byte_offset can overflow usize (panic in debug, wraparound in release), bypassing the bounds check so an out-of-range DataView is created over the ArrayBuffer.

H02.description: Adds a regression test for the overflowing offset + length case.

H03.description: Parameterises the test helper for out-of-range dataview creation.

H04.description: Test helper uses the new parameters instead of fixed values.

H05.description: Adds test entry points for out-of-range and overflow cases.

H06.description: Registers the new overflow test function.
